what_to_detect: A ninjutsu resolution returns an unblocked attacker to its owner's hand and puts the ninjutsu card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
near_miss: A ninjutsu activation not allowed because the attacker is blocked, so no swap occurs.
record_fields: zone_change Hand to Battlefield and Battlefield to Hand in one effect half

what_to_detect: A creature put onto the battlefield attacking by ninjutsu attacks the same player or planeswalker as the creature it replaced.
near_miss: A creature entering attacking a different defender than the creature it replaced.
